blocks.text: Antigen molecule ka sirf aik chhota hissa antibody ki binding site mein fit hota hai. Is hisse ko determinant kehte hain. Kuch soorton mein bohat si mukhtalif antibodies aik hi antigen se jur sakti hain; har antibody antigen ki satah ke alag hisse mein fit hoti hai. Is qism ki antibody ko polyclonal antibody kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Choohe mein antigen ka teeka, us ki tilli se plasma cells (B cells). Cancer cells (myelomas) culture mein ugaye jate. Dono test tube mein milaye jate jahan cells jur kar hybridomas bante, aur hybridoma culture monoclonal antibodies banata.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Antigen injected into mouse, Plasma cells (B cells) from spleen, Cancer cells (myelomas) grown in culture, Cells fused to produce hybridomas, Hybridoma cell culture producing monoclonal antibodies.

blocks.text: Doosri taraf kuch antibodies sirf aik hi determinant se jurti hain. Inhein monoclonal antibodies kehte hain. 1984 mein Cesar Milstein aur Georges Köhler (kitab mein 'George Kohler') ko monoclonal antibody banane ka tareeqa maloom karne par Nobel Prize diya gaya. Apne tajurbe mein unhon ne antibodies banane wale plasma cells ko cancer cells, jinhein myelomas kehte hain, ke saath milaya. Unhein culture mein kuch naye cells barhte aur taqseem hote nazar aaye. Yeh cells, jinhein hybridomas kehte hain, antibodies banane ke liye plasma cell ke genes aur barhne aur taqseem hone ke liye myeloma ke genes istemal karte the. Hybridoma cells wahi antibody banate rahe jis ke liye un ka plasma cell khaas (specialized) tha. Is tarah unhein tezi se barhne wale hybridoma cells mile jo monoclonal antibodies bana rahe the.

Monoclonal antibodies bohat ahem sabit hui hain kyun ke in se paicheeda mixtures mein se khaas molecules alag kar ke saaf (purify) kiye ja sakte hain. Interferon isi tarah saaf kiya gaya tha. Medicine mein monoclonal antibodies khaas ilaaj ko sahi jagah pohanchane ki sawari (vehicle) ke taur par istemal hoti hain. Aise antigens par research jaari hai jo sirf cancer cells par hote hain, taa ke radioactive monoclonal antibodies ko un par nishana bana kar sirf cancer cells ko maara ja sake.

blocks.prompt: Vaccine saalon tak kyun bachati hai, jab ke bani banayi di gayi antibodies thori der?
blocks.explanation: Vaccine jism se uske apne memory B aur T cells banwati hai jo baad mein infection par foran tez jawab dete hain. Di gayi antibodies kuch arse mein khatam ho jati hain aur un se memory cells nahin bante.

items: Macrophage ke proteins helper T cells ko fa'al karte hain jo cell-mediated aur antibody-mediated immunity shuru karte hain.
Cell-mediated (T cells): proliferation, activation, induction, attack, suppression (1-2 hafte baad), memory.
Antibody-mediated (B cells): proliferation se plasma cells, antibodies ka secretion, attack (complement, macrophages, killer cells), suppression, memory B cells.
Antibody: Y shakal, 2 heavy + 2 light chains, disulfide bridges, variable regions binding site banate hain.
Monoclonal antibodies: aik determinant; plasma cell + myeloma = hybridoma (Milstein aur Köhler, 1984).
